title: Morning Note — broad news scan (1 demo priority name)
coverage_notes: Broad discovery covers companies beyond the list. This share copy includes only one demo priority name and excludes your private list.
Broad market discovery runs first. A company does not need to be in the priority list to become a research lead.
Every scanned market headline is retained in headline-audit.json. Keyword scores are only a first-pass ordering; AI research may promote overlooked items.
The collector checks the strongest leads within a per-source article limit. Unread, restricted, undated and unidentified leads remain visible for review.
The Codex plugin researches, translates and writes supported English summaries before passing them to the email formatter. The standalone collector does not perform AI analysis.
Publisher feeds and current headline pages have finite depth. This does not cover every major news website, every article or the full 24-hour archive.
Brave API search is optional and disabled. Full exchange feeds, paid news access, market-data calculations and email sending are not connected.

sources.name: SoftBank Group — official press releases
sources.coverage_note: Official company press feed; linked public release text is checked before drafting.

sources.name: Nikkei — public latest headlines
sources.coverage_note: Latest public list only; matching article access and original publication time are checked separately. No archive-wide keyword search.

sources.name: Yomiuri — public latest headlines

sources.name: Asahi — public latest headlines
sources.coverage_note: Index time-of-day alone is not a publication date. Matching articles need an independently parseable date or remain held.

sources.coverage_note: Publisher feed currently exposes 20 latest headlines, not a complete 24-hour archive.

sources.name: Sentaku — public issue headlines
sources.coverage_note: Monthly publication. An issue month cannot establish a 12/24-hour publication time; such matches remain review leads.

sources.name: Diamond — official latest feed
sources.coverage_note: Publisher feed currently exposes 25 latest items. Restricted bodies are not read; metadata stays in the review queue.

sources.name: Search across the six Japanese publishers — optional Brave API
sources.disabled_reason: Optional: use existing Brave access through BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY and run with --with-search. No account or subscription is required for normal public-source scans.

sources.name: RTHK — English finance news
sources.coverage_note: 20 recent English finance items observed. Hong Kong and regional finance; finite feed depth, not complete market coverage. Feed pubDate has an explicit +0800 offset; linked article access is checked.

sources.name: South China Morning Post — business headlines
sources.coverage_note: 50 recent business items observed, including companies across Asia. Feed timestamps carry explicit offsets. Restricted article bodies remain review leads; no subscription access or archive-wide search is connected.

sources.name: ABC Australia — business headlines
sources.coverage_note: Public business homepage cards only. Timestamped cards carry UTC datetimes; undated cards require original publication metadata from the article. Features can be old and live blogs can change after initial publication. ABC discontinued updating RSS feeds; this uses the current HTML page.

sources.name: Focus Taiwan — official English news feed
sources.coverage_note: 52 recent English items observed in the official site-advertised FeedBurner feed. Includes non-business stories, which need event relevance screening. Original feed dates include +0800; article publication and update timestamps remain distinct. Not a complete Taiwan news archive.
